subject: english
title: Word Twins
objective: Identify synonyms and antonyms by comparing word meanings.
introduction: Happy and glad are word twins — but hot and cold are opposites! 🐱✨ Help Milo sort them.

vocabulary.definition: Two words with almost the same meaning.
Two words that both mean to start something.

items.prompt: Which pair has words with similar meanings?
items.explanation: Happy and glad both mean feeling good, so they have similar meanings.

items.prompt: Which pair has words with matching meanings?
items.explanation: Begin and start both mean to get something going, so their meanings match.

items.prompt: Which pair has words with opposite meanings?
items.explanation: Hot and cold are opposites — one is warm and the other is chilly.
Early means before the time, and late means after it — opposite meanings.
Happy and glad are synonyms because they mean almost the same thing.
